nav-state.$description: Piqueray Figma variable 'NavState' — a STRING whose only value is 'Transparent'. Projected to the transparent color #00000000 (alpha 0): the token / Figma-variable pipeline has no string channel and NavState denotes transparency. From-dump semantics; the hex is the faithful color projection.
